summary: Agent implemented a substantial fold generator, but the hidden tests failed at test compilation because generated fold code for a generic implementation referenced an undeclared type variable.
quick_failure_summary: Generated fold code does not compile for a generic nested implementation case.

details.reasoning: The verifier stopped during Maven testCompile before any tests ran. The raw log reports /app/value-fixture/target/generated-test-sources/test-annotations/org/immutables/fixture/fold_c8b14d/MeterSpecFold.java:[14,32] cannot find symbol: class T in interface MeterSpecFold<R>. The agent's generator emits case parameter types using type.typeAbstract().toString(), so a generic implementation such as MeterSpec.GaugeB<T> leaks T into the non-generic fold interface. The prompt explicitly required implementations with their own type parameters to still get cases, so the generated companion needed to use a compilable erased or wildcarded nested type for those cases.
details.secondary_factors: The baseline suite is also reported failed because the same test-compilation failure prevented the wrapper from producing normal JUnit results; this is not evidence of a separate pre-existing environment problem. The agent validated compile goals but not a testCompile path containing generic generated test fixtures.

problem_assessment.notes: The feature is broad and challenging for an annotation processor, but the failing generic-implementation requirement was explicitly stated in the prompt. The hidden tests deterministically expose the generated-code compilation error.

evidence: junit_base.xml reports 326/326 baseline failures and junit_new.xml reports 47/47 new failures only because both suites were missing from JUnit XML after wrapper exit code 1.
test_execution.log shows Maven testCompile failed with one real error: MeterSpecFold.java:[14,32] cannot find symbol class T in interface MeterSpecFold<R>.
test.patch defines MeterSpec.GaugeB<T> extends Gauge and a test named genericImplementationGetsACaseAndFolds, matching the prompt's explicit generic-implementation requirement.
agent_solution.patch shows Case.getDeclaredType() returns type.typeAbstract().toString(), which can emit MeterSpec.GaugeB<T> inside the non-generic Fold interface.
trajectory.json shows the agent successfully ran clean compile commands and was not blocked by missing dependencies or runtime setup; it simply did not validate the failing testCompile scenario.
environment_assessment.finding: No meaningful external blocker was found; the failure is caused by invalid generated Java for generic implementation cases.
